NGA.note: Tax directive only; no conduct rules or redress.

facts.fact: Vanguard reports the federal government directed banks and fintechs to collect 7.5% VAT from 19 January 2026 on fees for services such as mobile money transfers and USSD transactions.
facts.system: mobile money transfers and USSD transactions

NGA.note: VAT collected by banks on fees and remitted to the Nigerian Revenue Service; no electronic payment channel for taxpayers stated.
